questions.question: Who is pictured coming from Edom with crimson garments in Isaiah 63?
options: A prophet who was sent to warn all of the proud and lofty nations
A shining angel bearing in his hand a great scroll of fierce judgment
A victorious king returning home from a great victory in battle
The LORD, mighty to save, having trodden the winepress of wrath
questions.answer: The LORD, mighty to save, having trodden the winepress of wrath

questions.question: What does Isaiah 63 recall about God's past dealings with Israel?
options: His many judgments poured out on all the nations round about
His steadfast love and how he carried them in days of old
His sure and certain promise to send a coming Messiah
His everlasting covenant first made with Abraham of old
questions.answer: His steadfast love and how he carried them in days of old

questions.question: Isaiah 63 addresses God as 'our Father,' even if Abraham does not know us.
I have trodden the winepress alone, and from the peoples no one was with _____.
You, O LORD, are our _____; our Redeemer from of old is your name.
